web.named_query: ("Central Intelligence Agency" OR "Michael Ellis") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: Michael Ellis said AI could reduce tasks that once took months or years to hours or days and called it a potential “game changer” that could fundamentally reshape the intelligence business. He said such models can bring knowledge and capabilities previously held only by nation-states to a wide range of actors, and that AI would help CIA analysts draft key judgments, edit for clarity, and compare drafts against tradecraft standards. Ellis said CIA is entering commercial partnerships in areas including AI and that it should not let private companies dictate how and when CIA makes lawful use of their technologies. He described competition with China as unlike anything the United States has faced and said the U.S. must continue to lead the AI race, citing President Trump’s AI Action Plan as setting up the private sector to win that race.
